subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about pulling guests who browsed dates back to a paid booking, given that travel cart abandonment sits near 86 percent. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the completed booking itself, the confirmed and paid reservation read back through an S2S postback via your MMP, and we hold it through a window so cancellations do not flatter the line. At scale that runs around 4,000 retargeted bookings a day on this supply (illustrative). Want me to walk you through the read on comparable UK inventory?
illustrative_flags: around 4,000 retargeted bookings a day on this supply (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN travel_and_booking: references prior in S1 (browsed-dates retargeting + 86% abandonment detail from parent); restates single proof (optimize to completed booking + S2S postback via MMP + retention window vs cancellations); one illustrative figure (~4,000 retargeted bookings/day); soft CTA, 1 question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; X-not-Y avoided; native UK English.
